English.Char_Desc_250: ReviveUSB gets your files back from a USB drive or SD card that Windows asks to format, shows as RAW or won't open, then makes the drive usable again. It copies the drive to an image first and only reads it while recovering.
English.Char_Desc_450: ReviveUSB is a free, portable Windows tool for a USB drive, SD card or external disk that Windows asks to format, shows as RAW or won't open. It copies the whole drive to an image first, then recovers current and deleted files from NTFS, FAT32 and exFAT with their names and folders. When names are gone it finds photos, videos, PDFs and ZIP files by signature. Afterwards it can check, format or rebuild the drive and copy your files back.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
ReviveUSB is a free Windows tool for a USB drive, SD card or external disk that Windows suddenly asks you to format, shows as RAW, or will not open. It gets your files back first, then makes the drive usable again.
Recovery only reads from the drive. ReviveUSB copies the whole drive to an image file first, skipping unreadable areas so the copy doesn't stall, and it resumes if interrupted. It then recovers files from the image: current and deleted files from NTFS, FAT32 and exFAT, with their original names and folders, even when Windows can't open the drive. When the file system is gone, it finds photos, videos (MP4, MOV), PDFs and ZIP files by their content.
After your files are safe, ReviveUSB can check the drive, format it or rebuild it, test it for fake capacity and failing areas, and copy the recovered files back with verification. It refuses to repair a drive that shows signs of a failing controller.
One exe file, no installation (about 8 MB), available in 11 languages. Free, no ads. Recovery is never guaranteed, and repair commands erase data permanently.
